about_the_game:
Welcome to Weeb Store Simulator.

Where your dream of running the ultimate anime and gaming store comes to life! As the manager, you’ll start with a humble selection of items, but with hard work and smart decisions, you’ll unlock new licenses, expand your inventory, and turn your store into a bustling otaku paradise.

Co-op Multiplayer

Team up with friends in co-op multiplayer mode to manage the store together! Assign roles, stock shelves, handle customers, and watch your business grow. From rare collectibles to the latest gaming gear, every item you sell brings you closer to becoming the top weeb store in town.

Key Features:

  • 🎮 Sell a Variety of Otaku Goods: Games, consoles, figurines, manga, comics, and more!

  • 👥 Co-op Multiplayer: Manage your store with friends and build the ultimate anime haven together.

  • 📈 Grow Your Business: Unlock new licenses, expand your inventory, and customize your store.

  • 🛍️ Customer Interactions: Deal with quirky customers, fulfill special requests, and keep your store running smoothly.

  • 🏆 Build Your Legacy: Start small, dream big, and create the most iconic weeb store in the world!

Whether you’re a seasoned manager or a casual anime fan, Weeb Store Simulator offers endless fun and challenges. Gather your friends, stock those shelves, and let’s build the ultimate otaku empire together!
